name: Booster mission
summary: Launch and land a Falcon 9-class booster live: the precomputed launch, flip and entry burn, then the learned policy lands it on the drone ship.
help: Wire the policies of Booster landing: train (its dataset: each training adds a booster_policy_<date>_<NN>pct.pt) to Policies and the block's telemetry, through a Telemetry block, to one or more 3D views. The block reads every policy, lists them in the log newest first with how often each landed in training, and flies the newest that has finished its lessons (or the one Policy file names; with none finished, the newest). Press Launch (control channel, from the 3D view's or a Controls view's buttons): a 10-second countdown in real seconds, lift-off on nine engines, max-Q (about T+1:02, 11 km), main engine cut-off (about T+2:34, 71 km, 2.4 km/s) and separation 3 s later; the second stage lights its vacuum engine and burns to orbit (about 7.8 km/s near 200 km, cut-off near T+8:30). The booster flips on nitrogen thrusters (a push to start the turn, a quiet coast at about 9 deg/s, a push the other way to stop it), grid fins out, coasts up to about 120 km, makes the three-engine entry burn, then the learned policy flies the grid-fin glide and the single-engine landing burn to the drone ship about 650 km downrange, which waits where the booster would fall without steering (Ship offset moves it); its deck stands 4 m above the calm sea. Touchdown is simulated as a collision: from the first foot on the deck, the booster is a rigid body on four legs (stiff springs with crushable cores that yield and can fail, friction on the deck; the engine skirt and the tank can hit it too) on the heaving, pitching, rolling deck, and that decides whether it stands or topples. The flight ends 6 s after touchdown; after Flights per run flights (1 by default) the run ends by itself. Real time by default, Time warp up to 20x. Wind (m/s at the sea, growing with height), Jet stream (m/s near 11 km) and Sea (0 calm to 1 rough: the deck heaves, pitches and rolls) take effect at the next Launch. Channel rocket carries the flight (esasim.rocket/1: 20 frames a second, plus alt_km, speed_kmh, throttle, prop_t, downrange_km, q_kpa, to_ship_km, phase, clock for gauges); channel event the milestones; flights.csv the results.

inputs.label: Policies
inputs.help: The booster_policy*.pt files from Booster landing: train (wire its dataset: every training adds one); the newest that has finished its lessons is flown unless Policy file names one

outputs.label: Flights
outputs.help: flights.csv: each flight's wind, sea, result, distance from the centre, touchdown speed and lean

params.label: Wind (m/s)
params.help: At the sea, growing with height; with gusts

params.label: Sea (0-1)
params.help: 0 calm, 1 rough: how much the deck heaves, pitches and rolls

params.label: Time warp
params.help: 1 = real time (a flight takes about 8 minutes); the countdown always takes 10 real seconds

params.label: Ship offset (m)
params.help: Moves the drone ship downrange from where the booster would fall unsteered

params.label: Policy file
params.help: Empty: the newest policy that has finished its lessons (the date and time in its name). Or part of a file name (such as 20261109_1203) to fly that one

params.label: Flights per run
params.help: The run ends by itself after this many flights (6 s after the last touchdown); 0: it waits for Launch until stopped

params.label: Launch at once
params.help: Off: wait for the Launch button
